fact: The African Development Bank notice says Tunisia intends to use loan funds for a contract to set up an e-Justice services portal and a business application for the Ministry of Justice.
system: Portail de Services E-Justice et Application Métier

fact: The Minister of Justice authorised on 25 May 2023 the pilot of the Jshare platform for electronic exchange of civil court documents in a number of model courts, with training of judges, lawyers and clerks to start.
